Definition: from πάλλω (to vibrate; another form for G906); wrestling:--+ wrestle.
BiblicalUsage: Palē is wrestling, hand-to-hand struggle. Paul says we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this one verse reframes every fight I face: the real opponent is never the person in front of me, but the darkness behind them.
